title: fin.priority_routing
description: The priority routing member of a pack (PCK-09; ruling A644, interim, relayed, not yet committed): for each SLA phase, a priority (HIGH, NORMAL or LOW) and the owner queue. Every phase of the pack's sla_phase (the clock statuses) must have an entry (A660, interim, relayed, not yet committed), and the Go reader gives no default for a phase it does not list. `tools/packcheck manifest` also checks that every phase is one the pack's sla_phase names, that none is missing, and every queue is in the pack's routing_allowlist; the Go reader (`platform/priorityrouting`) refuses the same shapes. Pack data (SoT 51); a change is reviewed by a Founder (AGENT-16). SYNTHETIC.
